## Checklist

- [ ] I personally opened every source I cite, and it says what I cite it for.
- [ ] I did **not** invent, guess or copy citations from somewhere without checking them.
      If I used an AI tool, I checked every reference against the original.
- [ ] Every citation has a **locator** (page, verse, figure or headword).
- [ ] Evidence levels describe **what kind of source** each one is (CONTRIBUTING.md, rule 3).
- [ ] Statements are worded no more strongly than the evidence allows.
- [ ] Anything I haven't fully checked is marked `unverified`, with a note saying what to check.
- [ ] Summaries are in my own words; I didn't paste abstracts or copyrighted text.
- [ ] No personal or genetic data about living individuals.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes (or the automatic check passed).
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is licensed under the project's licences
      (MIT for code, CC BY-SA 4.0 for data and writing).
